# Test fixtures

Frozen copies of the Measure files of this repository. The tests read these files, not the live files, so an archive of the track does not break the tests.

Source commit: `a64c01f`.

- `index.md` from `measure/index.md`
- `tracks.md` from `measure/tracks.md`
- `plan.md` from `measure/tracks/opencode_plugin_20261021/plan.md`
